author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** New polaris-frontend/src/pages/login.rs Leptos page: handle input + Continue button + helpful copy. Uses a REAL <form method='POST' action='/auth/atproto/login'> — NOT a fetch() call — so the backend's 303 from #67 redirects the browser through bsky.social and back. Body: { handle: <input value> } as application/x-www-form-urlencoded OR application/json — backend handler expects JSON Body per #67's handler. Need a tiny form-data → JSON shim OR just use a fetch() that follows redirects manually. Check #67's actual signature.
